settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: We offer cheap, fast delivery anywhere in Victoria. Exact rates are calculated at checkout based on your postcode and order size.

settings.question: Can I pick up my order instead?
settings.answer: Yes - local pickup is available same-day from our Moonee Ponds warehouse in Melbourne.

settings.question: How hard is assembly?
settings.answer: Our rivet shelving units use a tool-free boltless design, so most units can be assembled solo in under 30 minutes. Full step-by-step instructions are available on our Assembly Instructions page.

settings.question: What warranty is included?
settings.answer: Every unit is covered by a full 12 month warranty against manufacturing defects.

settings.question: How much weight can each shelf hold?
settings.answer: Load capacity varies by range - our steel shelving units hold up to 150kg per shelf, with full specifications listed on each product page.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Everything you need to know about delivery, assembly, and warranty.
